title: Blue Mountain Beach "Worlds Away on 30A" 100 Snapper Street
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Worlds Away on 30A" 100 Snapper Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Private pool coming Summer, 2026- Private fenced-in yard- 6 Passenger LSV golf cart- 4 adult bikes- Private office- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Worlds Away on 30A is where coastal fun awaits! This lovely 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom Blue Mountain Beach home sleeps 10 guests. Tucked at the end of a quiet street, guests enjoy a peaceful retreat while being within walking distance of restaurants and beach access—less than a mile away. Hop on the Timpoochee Trail and cruise to the beach or stop for a sweet treat at the beloved Blue Mountain Beach creamery!Open and bright, the first level of this charming 2-story abode offers a relaxing, coastal atmosphere curated by classic wainscoting, sea-inspired artwork, and rattan accents. After a day of sun and sand, sink into the soft L-shaped sofa to unwind and watch TV in the living space—2 stylish accent chairs provide extra seating. The chef of the group will love the kitchen’s open layout, granite countertops, gleaming appliances, and 2-stool breakfast bar, where guests can visit over a morning caffeine boost. A few steps away is a round glass dining table for 6. Step outside to find a beautiful fenced-in backyard surrounded by lush foliage. Settle into the cushioned patio furnishings for a quiet nightcap, or light up the grill to savor a meal under the glowing string lights. There’s an outdoor shower for additional convenience, and a laundry room on this level. When it’s time to turn in, a beautifully appointed guest bedroom with a queen bed welcomes rest.On the second level, the spacious primary bedroom boasts a king bed, private bathroom, porch, and attached private office—ideal for mixing work with play. Enjoy a plush king bed in the guest bedroom and plenty of space in the bunk room with 2 queen-over-queen beds.Leave worries behind at Worlds Away on 30A in Blue Mountain Beach. Exploring the area is easy with on-site parking—plus a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle and 4 complimentary adult bikes. For the nearest beach access, take Snapper Street to West County Highway 30A, then Blue Mountain Road to Old Blue Mountain Road, and beach access will be on the right. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs not to exceed 40lbs, for an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
